subject: Capacity uplift approval request — Runtime/Platform SWE (Q4)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity uplift approval request — Runtime/Platform SWE (Q4)

Team,

We need approval for +1 FTE (SWE, runtime/platform) to be added to the Q4 hiring slate to support the throughput initiative (shorter tail latency + 2x token/sec for burst workloads). Summary:

- Role: Senior SWE (Runtime/Platform) — target level L5 (may consider L4 strong if comp constraints).
- Rationale: Upcoming customer pilots (three enterprise trials) will increase concurrent session load by estimated 40% starting Nov. Without additional headcount we’ll incur either increased infra cost (autoscale 2.3x) or higher latency SLO misses.
- Expected impact: ~15–20% system tail latency reduction (via KV cache optimizations + continuous-batching changes) and ~18% reduction in per-token GPU bill when combined with caching.
- Cost: Fully loaded annual cost ~ $220k (comp + benefits + infra overhead). See attached hc_authorization_model_v3.xlsx for breakdown and sensitivity.
- Timeframe: need req approved and posted by 9/6 to hit offer window for October start.

We’ve got active leads from TalentBridge (Emma Hayes) — two candidates screened with runtime experience and quantization exposure. I’ve attached the pipeline export and a draft offer redline for finance review.

Ask: approval to add headcount to runtime/platform hiring slate for Q4 and sign-off on L5 comp band (with ability to flex to L4 in rare cases). If approved, I’ll route to TalentOps to start offers.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc_authorization_model_v3.xlsx, talentbridge_pipeline_aug2027.csv

Subject: Re: Capacity uplift approval request — Runtime/Platform SWE (Q4)

Aditya — thanks for the write-up. A few clarifying questions before I loop this to Finance: 

1) Can you call out the expected measurable OKRs tied to this hire (e.g., p95 latency target, token/sec improvement, estimated cost savings) and the timeline for seeing those?
2) Why L5 vs L4? Please justify with retention/bench strength and market comp evidence.
3) Confirm whether this is a new headcount (net new) or a reclassification/repurpose of an existing approved slot.

Also, can you upload a short two-slide executive summary (1 slide impact, 1 slide cost) to the linked HCREQ ticket? I will need that for the finance review. Looping in Evelyn and Markus for ops and comp band guidance.

- Laura

+1 to the hire; we need capacity aligned to the Q4 pilots. A couple notes: 

- L5 ask makes sense given the specialized runtime + quantization exposure; open-market comps for similar roles are tracking higher than L4 midpoint.
- If we go L4 we will almost certainly lose the stronger candidates to FAANGs — retention risk is material.
- Recommend we authorize up to 20% above L5 midpoint for exceptional hires (approvals routed through comp committee).

Aditya, please include expected recruiting timeline and interview loop (take-home, tech loop, behavioral) and whether we need take-home test specific to attention/kv-cache work.

— Markus

Subject: Re: Capacity uplift approval request — Runtime/Platform SWE (Q4)

Thanks for the quick replies — adding the details below and uploaded the two-slide brief to HCREQ-5421. I’ve also attached the redlined offer for comp review.

OKRs / measurable targets (first 12 weeks):
- Reduce p95 generation latency by 12–18% on production traffic for enterprise trials (measured weekly).
- Increase sustained token/sec (concurrency normalized) by 2x for burst window test harness (benchmarked in staging).
- Deliver KV-cache change with <5% regression to median latency; validate via canary.

Why L5:
- Market comps: L5 midpoints reflect +15–25% premium vs L4 for specialized runtime infra with quantization and kernel work (see attached spreadsheet tab).
- Retention: Two recent ramp hires in infra showed 18% higher retention at L5 vs L4 in first 18 months.

Recruiting timeline & loop:
- Posting live 9/6; first-round screens w/ TalentBridge week of 9/13; onsite/loop week of 9/27; aim for offer 10/4.
- Interview loop: 30m take-home perf/design, 90m onsite (runtime design, kernel/quantization deep-dive, systems coding), hiring manager + peer sync.

Pipeline: TalentBridge has two screened candidates (Priya Suresh and an unnamed IC). Priya has LLM-inference experience and is willing to relocate/remote. Emma attached CSV.

Routing: If we get approval today for headcount + L5 band flexibility, I’ll route offer to offer-ops and include the redline for finance signoff (DocuSign link below).

DocuSign (offer template): https://redwood.docusign.com/abcd-2027-offer
Uploaded: offer_SWE_runtime_L5_redline.pdf, hc_authorization_model_v3.xlsx, talentbridge_pipeline_aug2027.csv

Thanks,
Aditya

Aditya / team — approved subject to the two items below. Thanks for the details and the HCREQ write-up.

Approval conditions:
1) Finance to confirm funding source & GL code (Laura, please confirm allocation from Q4 operational headroom or product growth quota).
2) Offer-ops to confirm total cash + equity structure fits comp band gating; use comp committee reroute if the final offer exceeds +20% midpoint.

Actionable next steps:
- Laura: confirm GL allocation to HCREQ-5421.
- Offer-ops (cc): review attached offer_SWE_runtime_L5_redline.pdf; if clean, prep DocuSign envelope for Priya.
- Aditya: once DocuSign sent, please add expected start date to the ticket and mark candidate pipeline as "primary"/"backup".

I’m writing this as formal approval for the headcount slate — proceed with TalentOps.

Best,
